# Bundled font notices

Carrot Manga Translator bundles the original, unmodified font files listed in
[`manifest.json`](manifest.json). They are grouped in the font picker by the
script they are intended to cover; a font may contain additional scripts too.

Every bundled file remains under its upstream license. The matching license
text is stored in the directory named after the font ID. The font files may not
be sold by themselves, and modified versions must follow any Reserved Font Name
rules in their license.

The SHA-256 values and exact upstream revisions used for this copy are recorded
in [`manifest.json`](manifest.json).

The six Korean additions use upstream TTF files except RIDIBatang, whose
official unmodified download is OTF. Gaegu includes its Light, Regular, and
Bold TTF faces. Cafe24's official Korean license PDF and the upstream copyright
notices for RIDIBatang, Cafe24 OnePrettyNight, and NAVER's Start Over are kept
in their matching directories.

## Intentionally not bundled

[KOMACON (만화진흥원체)](https://www.komacon.kr/b_sys/index.asp?b_code=4&b_mode=view&b_sq=19741&nowPage=1&s_cate=1&s_fld=&s_txt=)
is not bundled because its embedded copyright notice prohibits copying and
redistribution without prior approval; the
[Noonnu license summary](https://noonnu.cc/font_page/253) records the same
restriction. Its official download is an installer rather than a
redistributable TTF package. It can be added only after the copyright holder
grants separate redistribution rights.

The Apache-licensed fonts also include their upstream copyright notices:
[`Luckiest Guy`](luckiest-guy/NOTICE.txt) and
[`Permanent Marker`](permanent-marker/NOTICE.txt).
